status: One source-located field topology and datum test; not a sealed barrier or selected structural arrangement

fieldControl.scope: Bounding shape only: door/threshold returns, service openings, joints, structural bands, support cuts and actual coverage are not laid out. This is not a cut list or net quantity.

negativeControls.upperBed: 3 mm plate occupies the upper 3 mm of the 10 mm bed, leaving 7 mm beneath; adjacent 1 mm sheet splits it into 7 mm below and 2 mm above. Neither joint, bearing nor monolithic lateral transfer is established.

slabDatum.result: FAIL on unchanged HAD ground slab: 2 mm clear vs 40 mm trial rail, 38 mm overlap. MAT alternative permits nominal spatial reservation only; adoption, hanger anchorage and insulation repair remain unproved.

negativeControls.girder: Even in MAT slab alternative, field top −382 is only 2 mm below −380 girder soffit; a 40 mm top-side rail cannot continue through it. End supports, welded transitions, reinforced contact and accessible sequencing are not designed.
negativeControls.courtServiceAlternative: The distinct joined-ground service reference starts its DPC field at −380; −383 lies within the upper 3 mm of that DPC band. Its W1 carrier crown −378 and invert −538 straddle the metal plane; a flat sheet intersects the carrier 5 mm below its crown. The independent W2 tray, air lid −310..−316 and seal to −318 also require their own continuous, accessible transitions. This is an incompatible reference comparison, not an assertion both designs are selected.

floorCandidate.source: HAD RC200 and joined-ground 100 mm glass are coordinated candidates, not an adopted material/whole-floor assembly
floorCandidate.limit: Core-only one-dimensional glass resistance, no whole-floor U or thermal bridge result.

warmPad.limit: The projected rectangle is from first-floor SW-L; actual ground slab plan is not established. Pad occupies local 100 mm glass territory only if this HAD-aligned build-up is adopted; concrete/slab reinforcement, actual casting, thermal bridge and non-double-counted takeoff unproved.

hypotheticalMeshControl.groundMeshStatus: H12/150 and 25 mm cover are first-floor source values only; not established ground reinforcement.
hypotheticalMeshControl.regularGridResult: If studs are fixed to 200 mm grid and mesh repeats at 150 mm, residues 0/50/100 give some centre separation at most25 mm for any phase; after radii9 mm clear at best16 mm, below illustrative22 mm comparator.
hypotheticalMeshControl.limit: This is a hypothetical mesh and ideal plan only. Actual ground cage, bar layers, physical stud locations, edge coverage, weld/access, transfer and 22 mm applicability are not established; no accepted stud array.

falseworkCell.supports: 36 trial prop heads in an isolated cell at 200 mm grid below double 40 mm angles; neighbouring cells may share edges. Actual whole-site count, prop feet, foundation, lateral stability, access, loads and removal route not designed.
falseworkCell.limit: One clear 1 m cell, straight angle idealisation. No stability, allowable, fastener or physical acceptance. Studs are a detachable-form retention hypothesis, not composite reinforcement or approved concrete connection.

HADAlignedDirection.decision: HAD-aligned floor is the preferred development basis only. MAT −80/−280 remains unadopted whole-house-rewind comparator; field, formwork, seams, all perimeter/box/threshold/penetrations and material/site acceptance remain open.

flushSoffitTrial.HADdirectContact: Field top coincides with selected HAD slab soffit; sheet may be used as permanent formwork only with a fully designed support, bond, movement and sealing strategy.
flushSoffitTrial.MATlimit: General MAT slab remains 100 mm above the field, so no slab/formwork load or bond is assumed. Warm receiving girder alone reaches −380.
flushSoffitTrial.controlLimit: 1 m-wide, 1 mm thick ideal simply supported strip with E200 GPa under 5 kPa only; excludes plate action, membrane action, restraints and all work/live/water loads. Large deflection and possible yielding invalidate the linear estimate, so it is a failure indicator for this idealization, not a physical prediction or actual plate capacity.
flushSoffitTrial.scope: Top-aligned 1mm field leaves 9mm below within nominal 10mm bed, while 3mm patch leaves 7mm; field-to-patch underside steps 2mm. Neither metal/concrete contact, bed nor the stepped weld is qualified.

movementChallenge.scope: Illustrative uniform temperatures and free strains only; not an imposed joint movement or measured site condition. A 40 mm wide 15 mm deep folded-metal loop cannot simply pass through these walls and receivers; design continuous terminations, structural bearing, actual restraint, fatigue, gas seal, inspection and repair.

serviceBoxWrap.route: Field at −381 turns down the two exterior 1003-wide box faces, passes under the RC underside −839.5, and rises on the other side; 840 length is one part of a continuous wrap, not a removable section. W1 and its lid remain above the retained field.
serviceBoxWrap.hold: Node-side DPC/bearing piers may intersect the fold; ends, turns, fixed collars, continuous corner welds, concrete-on-metal support and friction separation, W2 drainage, site pressure, movement, inspection and repair are unproved. Do not count the geometry as a sealed field or assume access below the box.

panelSensitivity.limit: Local gross self-weight only, no overlap/anchors/welds, glass support, pressure, water, construction or design factors. No stiffness or anchor capacity.
